visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a plain white t-shirt and blue jeans walks into a hotel room holding a small gift wrapped in blue paper with yellow animal patterns. The room is brightly lit with warm indoor lighting, featuring a bed and a hallway entrance. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of two gifts, one large and one small, both wrapped in the same blue festive paper. A woman's hands are seen holding the larger one. (3) A woman in a red ribbed sweater sits by a large window with a night city view. She begins unwrapping the small gift, her facial expressions showing curiosity and amusement as she reveals a white DJI box inside. (4) She continues to unwrap the package, opening the DJI box to find it is reused, containing a smaller pink Pandora jewelry box and a Disney Dumbo charm. She smiles broadly and shows the charm to the camera. (5) The man, now seated on the bed, begins tearing the paper off the larger gift. He looks suspicious and smiles at the woman. Inside the wrapping is a white box labeled MacBook Air. (6) He opens the laptop box to find a handwritten cardboard sign that reads 'MacBook Pro 螢幕贊助金 15000元'. He bursts into loud laughter, holding the sign up for the camera while talking to the woman.
